# Imposia 0.8.1

Imposia 0.8.1 fixes typesetting of wide tables and tall cells and makes the
standalone HTML export independent of what the preview happened to render. There
are no API changes, no new options, and no migration note.

## Fixes

- **Body width.** A table wider than the page body no longer widens the body or
  changes the width of other tables; the body stays the sheet width minus the
  side margins, and column widths are measured under that constraint.
- **Cells broken over pages.** `box-decoration-break` is honored: `slice` keeps
  the top decoration on the first piece and the bottom one on the last piece of
  the row, for every cell including an emptied continuation, and `clone` keeps
  it on every piece. Space freed by a cut decoration is used, and putting the
  bottom decoration back never leaves the last piece past the body.
- **HTML export.** `exportPageDocumentHtml()` renders every page before it
  measures anchored elements, so positions no longer depend on scrolling. All
  anchored elements, inline or from a stylesheet, are frozen at their position
  in their containing block, and every exported page paints under `screen` and
  `print` media.

## Upgrade

Update all four packages together:

```sh
npm install @imposia/core@0.8.1 @imposia/viewer@0.8.1 @imposia/client@0.8.1 @imposia/react@0.8.1
```
